targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(journey_id) AS journeys FROM product_events FINAL WHERE journey_id != '' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT uniqExact(journey_id) AS verified_journeys FROM product_events FINAL WHERE event_type = 'merchant.verified.v1' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT event_type, uniqExact(event_id) AS events, uniqExact(journey_id) AS journeys FROM product_events FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT variant, countIf(event_type = 'recommendation.impressed.v1') AS impressions, countIf(event_type = 'recommendation.clicked.v1') AS clicks, countIf(event_type = 'redemption.succeeded.v1') AS redemptions, countIf(event_type = 'merchant.verified.v1') AS verified FROM product_events FINAL WHERE variant != '' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY variant ORDER BY impressions DESC
SELECT attribution_type, uniqExact(journey_id) AS journeys FROM product_events FINAL WHERE attribution_type != '' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY attribution_type ORDER BY journeys DESC
